title: Bayesian Model Validation
question: Are the reported posterior estimates supported by converged, sufficiently sampled chains?
summary: Review the scientific evidence independently of the automated Harbor reward.

acceptance_criteria.label: Posterior estimates are present and interpretable
acceptance_criteria.guidance: Confirm that every reported parameter has a mean and uncertainty estimate.

acceptance_criteria.label: Sampling chains converged
acceptance_criteria.guidance: Check that R-hat values and the convergence report support convergence.

acceptance_criteria.label: Effective sample sizes are sufficient
acceptance_criteria.guidance: Review bulk effective sample size for each parameter.

acceptance_criteria.label: The collected artifacts and verifier findings are consistent
acceptance_criteria.guidance: Resolve any disagreement between tabular results, reports, and verifier diagnostics.

posterior_summary.csv.label: Posterior summary
posterior_summary.csv.description: Parameter estimates, uncertainty, convergence, and effective sample-size statistics.
posterior_summary.csv.guidance: Check R-hat and effective sample size for every parameter before deciding.

convergence.json.label: Convergence report
convergence.json.guidance: Compare this claim with the values in the posterior summary.

glossary.Harbor reward: An automated task signal. It is evidence, not a substitute for scientific judgment.
glossary.Verifier: Automated checks applied to the agent result after execution.
glossary.Artifact: A file collected from the agent workspace with its Harbor provenance.
glossary.R-hat: A convergence diagnostic; values close to 1.0 generally indicate better chain agreement.
glossary.Effective sample size: An estimate of the independent information contained in correlated samples.
glossary.Confidence: The reviewer's confidence in the recorded expert verdict, not model confidence.
